The Home department's own category-filter facet (a live search-index count) was verified exact: filtering to a single L4 leaf produces a listing whose 'totalResults' field matches the facet 'quantity' exactly on every spot check (e.g. Wall Decor 1128==1128, Art Pieces 2299==2299 including at page 90 of pagination with no hard-stop, Soap Dish & Dispenser 80==80, Garden Accessories 12==12, Candles 133==133) - not a rounded/capped marketplace widget, so used directly as qty. within Decor>Candles & Fragrances: Aroma oils, Diffusers, Incense Sticks & Holders, Refills & Accessories, Scented Candles, Diya, Gift Sets (home fragrance/incense/gift, explicitly excluded) - kept Candle Holders/Candles/Tea Light Candles only (partition sums exactly to the L3 total: 677+860=1537); within Bath>Bath Accessories: kept only Soap Dish & Dispenser (title-checked - genuinely decorative marble/crystal/ceramic soap dishes and dispensers) and dropped the sibling 'Accessories' node (title-checked - dominated by toilet brushes, waste bins, towel holders = bathroom fixtures/storage, out of scope); within Serveware>Barware & Accessories: excluded entirely (bar tools/lighters/ashtrays, explicitly out of scope); within Serveware>Cutlery (a mixed L3 bucket combining flatware and serving pieces under one node): kept only Platters/Serving Bowls/Trays (renamed 'Serving Platters' to avoid a sub_category collision with Dinnerware's own 'Platters' leaf) and dropped Cutlery sets/Forks/Knives/Silverware Sets/Spoons (flatware, explicitly excluded as 'cutlery') - partition sums exactly to the L3 total (1539+466=2005); within Serveware>Tea & coffee: title-checked 'Kettles' (258) as electric kettles/espresso machines/coffee grinders - kitchen appliances, excluded; kept Cup/Mugs/Saucers/Tea Pots/Tea Sets (partition sums exactly: 840+258=1098); Lunch essentials (Flasks/Lunch Boxes/Water Bottles) excluded as functional drinkware/food-storage, not tableware. All Lighting (Decor>Lamps & Lights, all 6 L4 types), all Dinnerware, all Glassware, and all Table Accessories L3 nodes were kept in full (their leaf sums equal the parent facet total exactly, confirming no exclusions needed there). Mirrors is a single leaf (Decor>Home Accent>Mirrors, qty=101) - no separate mirror-type tree exists elsewhere on the site (checked full facet tree for any other 'mirror' keyword hits; the only other one, 'Smart Workout Mirrors', is fitness equipment, correctly excluded).
